description: Add disposition system to server.js - new applyDisposition function, update getNextNumber to skip dead/blocked/followup numbers, add REST API endpoints for disposition submission and querying interested/followup leads, update admin stats broadcast.
steps: In /projects/sandbox/Cluade/autolead-updated/server.js, create an applyDisposition(agentId, numberId, disposition, extra) function that handles all 6 dispositions: (1) 'dead' - set num.disposition='dead', num.dialedBy=agentId, num.dialedAt=now, clear num.assignedTo; (2) 'not_received' - clear num.assignedTo, clear num.dialedBy, so it goes back to pool; (3) 'not_interested' - set num.disposition='not_interested', num.blockedUntil=ISO date 30 days from now, num.dialedBy=agentId, num.dialedAt=now, clear num.assignedTo; (4) 'followup' - set num.disposition='followup', num.followupDate=extra.followupDate, num.followupTime=extra.followupTime, num.followupLockedBy=agentId, num.dialedBy=agentId, num.dialedAt=now, clear num.assignedTo; (5) 'switch_off' - same behavior as not_received, clear assignedTo and dialedBy; (6) 'interested' - set num.disposition='interested', num.interestedBy=agentId, num.interestedAt=now ISO, num.dialedBy=agentId, num.dialedAt=now, clear num.assignedTo. For all dispositions, increment agent.totalDialedToday, clear agent.currentNumberId, add to dialedLog, save state, broadcast admin stats.

Update getNextNumber(agentId) in server.js to skip numbers that match any of: (a) num.disposition === 'dead', (b) num.disposition === 'not_interested' AND num.blockedUntil AND new Date(num.blockedUntil) > new Date(), (c) num.disposition === 'followup' AND num.followupLockedBy !== agentId, (d) num.disposition === 'interested'. The filter should be: find first number where !num.dialedBy && !num.assignedTo AND none of the skip conditions apply.

Add POST /api/agent/disposition endpoint that accepts { agentId, numberId, disposition, followupDate?, followupTime? }. Validate disposition is one of the 6 valid values. Call applyDisposition and return success. Then get next number for agent and return it in response (or null if none).
Add GET /api/admin/interested endpoint that returns all numbers where disposition === 'interested', including phone, name, interestedBy (resolve to agent name), interestedAt.
Add GET /api/admin/followups endpoint that returns all numbers where disposition === 'followup', including phone, name, followupLockedBy (resolve to agent name), followupDate, followupTime.
Add GET /api/agent/interested/:agentId endpoint that returns numbers where disposition === 'interested' AND interestedBy === agentId.
Add GET /api/agent/followups/:agentId endpoint that returns numbers where disposition === 'followup' AND followupLockedBy === agentId.
Update getAdminStats() to include interestedCount (numbers with disposition=interested) and followupCount (numbers with disposition=followup) in the returned stats object.

Add a socket event 'agent-disposition' that accepts { agentId, numberId, disposition, followupDate?, followupTime? }, calls applyDisposition, then gets next number and emits 'show-number' or 'no-numbers' back to the socket (same pattern as 'agent-next' handler).
acceptance_criteria: node -c server.js passes without syntax errors
POST /api/agent/disposition with valid data applies the correct disposition to the number
getNextNumber skips dead numbers, 30-day blocked numbers, followup numbers locked by other agents, and interested numbers
GET /api/agent/interested/:agentId returns only that agent's interested leads
GET /api/agent/followups/:agentId returns only that agent's followups
Admin stats include interestedCount and followupCount
findings: Implementation complete. All 6 dispositions handled in applyDisposition(). getNextNumber() updated with skip logic. REST endpoints and socket event added. Syntax check passes cleanly.
